title: Signature Universal: The 3-Question Filter
description: Manon's 3-question filter universalizes decision-making: for any option ask — does it compound? does it survive my absence? would I want it if everyone did it? Options passing all three are rare and precious; most fail at least one. It compresses ethics, strategy, and systems thinking into thirty seconds. Signature original.

title: Signature Universal: The Attention Conservation Law
description: Manon's attention conservation law treats focus as a conserved quantity: attention spent is attention gone — it can be invested (deep work compounds) or dissipated (outrage, doomscrolling), never created from nothing. The practice is budgeting: decide the night before where tomorrow's attention goes, because the day will spend it somewhere regardless. Signature original.

title: Signature Universal: The Reversibility Test
